rare_regions.rare_region_code:
if (!csb0_reg && web0_reg)
  $display($time, " Reading %m addr0=%b dout0=%b", addr0_reg, mem[addr0_reg]);
rare_regions.activation_trigger: Read operation when chip is enabled and write is disabled
rare_regions.description: Displays memory read activity; typically occurs less frequently than regular writes depending on system usage patterns

rare_regions.rare_region_code:
if (!csb0_reg && !web0_reg)
  $display($time, " Writing %m addr0=%b din0=%b", addr0_reg, din0_reg);
rare_regions.activation_trigger: Write operation when chip is enabled and write is active
rare_regions.description: Displays memory write activity; may be infrequent if memory writes are rare compared to reads
